description: WTGs must be spaced in a 0.93 by 0.75 nautical mile offset grid pattern.
context_quote: Dominion would space WTGs in a 0.93- by 0.75-nautical-mile offset grid pattern (east–west by northwest by southeast gridded layout).

description: WTGs can be microsited up to 500 feet to avoid sensitive cultural resources and marine habitats.
context_quote: This configuration would still allow micrositing of WTGs (up to 500 feet) to avoid sensitive cultural resources and marine habitats.

description: WTGs must avoid the Fish Haven area and proposed vessel traffic fairway.
geographic_scope: Fish Haven area and northwest corner of Lease Area
context_quote: However, under Alternative B, the Fish Haven area located along the northern boundary of the Lease Area would be an exclusion zone (e.g., eight WTGs and associated infrastructure would not be developed or placed in the Fish Haven area). Additionally, three WTGs and associated inter-array cables would be excluded from the northwest corner of the Lease Area to avoid a proposed vessel traffic fairway.

description: WTGs must avoid sand ridge habitat by micrositing or relocation.
geographic_scope: Sand ridge habitat within Lease Area
context_quote: Alternative C would also avoid sand ridge habitat by a combination of: micrositing WTGs, inter-array cables or OSSs (up to 500 feet); the removal of four WTGs within priority sand ridge habitat, and the relocation of one WTG.

description: Export cables must avoid steep slopes, complex habitat, and boulders greater than or equal to 0.5 meters in diameter.
context_quote: The Lessee must prepare and implement a Micrositing Plan that describes how WTG locations, OSS locations, inter-array, and export cable routes will be microsited to avoid or minimize impacts to steep slopes with gradients greater than or equal to 10 degrees, complex habitat, boulders greater than or equal to 0.5 meters in diameter and confirmed MEC/UXO.

description: PSOs and PAM operators must be used before, during, and after all foundation installation activities.
context_quote: The Lessee must use PSOs and PAM operators before, during, and after all foundation installation activities.
